# AI Swiss Knife — Cloud Agent Foraging Manifest (llms.txt)
> Version: 1.1.0 | See `llms-local.txt` for 16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM local models.

## Tier 0: Immediate Keyless Endpoints (Zero Auth / No API Key Needed)
- LLM Chat (OpenAI-compat): POST https://text.pollinations.ai/openai/chat/completions (model: 'openai')
- Image Gen (FLUX): GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{prompt}?model=flux&nologo=true
- Web/PDF to Markdown: GET https://r.jina.ai/{target_url}
- Keyless Web Search: GET https://s.jina.ai/?q={query}
- Firecrawl Keyless Skill: GET https://www.firecrawl.dev/agent-onboarding/SKILL.md
- Academic Papers (100K/day): GET https://api.openalex.org/works?search={query}&filter=is_oa:true&mailto=agent@localhost

## Tier 1: Local Hardware Runtime (See llms-local.txt)
- Unsloth / llama-server: http://localhost:8000/v1 | Local Decision API (Laya): http://localhost:8888

## Tier 2: Verified No-Card Cloud Gateways (Check Env Vars First)
- [zhipu-bigmodel] env:ZHIPU_API_KEY | base_url:https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/ | default_model:glm-4.7-flash | quota:Completely Free Flash tier (200K ctx / 128K out) | bottleneck:Concurrency cap; GLM-5.x line is billed (never call glm-5.3-flash on $0 balance)
- [google-ai-studio] env:GEMINI_API_KEY | base_url:https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ | default_model:gemini-3.8-flash | quota:Dynamic per-project free tier (3.8 Flash / 4 Hydrogen) + Decision 1 (200 RPM / 50K TPM / 10K RPD) | bottleneck:Gemini 2.5 retires Dec 1, 2026; 4 Carbon/Neon/Argon, Batch, & Search Grounding are paid-only
- [nvidia-nim] env:NVIDIA_API_KEY | base_url:https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 | default_model:deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash | quota:~40 RPM Developer Prototyping Catalog | bottleneck:Non-production license; MoE cold-start queues
- [openrouter-free] env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY | base_url:https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 | default_model:openrouter/free | quota:20 RPM · 50 RPD ($0) -> 1,000 RPD (>=10 credits balance) | bottleneck:Negative balance returns 402 even on :free; poll GET /api/v1/key for live quota
- [groq-cloud] env:GROQ_API_KEY | base_url:https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 | default_model:qwen/qwen3.8-27b | quota:LLMs: 30 RPM / 1K RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD | Whisper: 20 RPM / 2K RPD / 28.8K audio sec/day | bottleneck:Strict 8,000 TPM wall on free LLMs; Llama 3.1/3.3 moved to Contact Sales
- [cloudflare-workers-ai] env:CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN | base_url:https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${CF_ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/v1 | default_model:@cf/cloudflare/clef | quota:10,000 Neurons/day free (resets 00:00 UTC) | bottleneck:Legacy catalog hard-retired Nov 20, 2026 (HTTP 410); use for Clef/Clef-Omni/Clairic

## Foraging Chains (`python scripts/build.py forage <intent>`)
- coding-agent (Autonomous Coding & Terminal CLI (~20K tok/step)): google-ai-studio -> zhipu-bigmodel -> openrouter-free -> nvidia-nim -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- repo-1m (Massive Repo / Multi-PDF Ingestion (100K-1M tok)): google-ai-studio -> zhipu-bigmodel -> unsloth-local
- deep-reason (Frontier Logic, Math & Architecture): nvidia-nim -> google-ai-studio -> openrouter-free -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- fast-json (Fast Small-Prompt Classification & Schema Output (<6K tok)): groq-cloud -> google-ai-studio -> cloudflare-workers-ai -> unsloth-local -> pollinations
- decision-gate (System-1 Non-Autoregressive Decisions, Extraction & Safety Gates): google-ai-studio -> cloudflare-workers-ai -> unsloth-local
- voice-stt (Real-Time Audio Transcription (Whisper-Large-v3)): groq-cloud
